daughter of the Rev.

John Collinson

One of the daughters of the Rev.

John Collinson, Rector of Boldon, wife of the Ven.

Henry de Winton (1823/4-1895), Archdeacon of Brecknock, sister of Sophia Jane (Collinson) Harrison. CMY’s connection with these families is described in Coleridge, Life, 31-3; and in her account of the fiction of Mrs Julia Stretton in Women Novelists of Queen Victoria’s Reign. [LG 1952; ODNB T.E.

Harrison; 1871 census]
